info.name: DocMonk - Clause Analyzer API
info.description:
# DocMonk Clause Analyzer API

Analyze PDF, DOCX, Markdown, or TXT documents against legal clauses using AI.

## Input
Send the document as a base64 string in the `document_base64` field.

## Supported File Formats
- PDF — auto-detected via magic bytes
- DOCX — auto-detected via magic bytes
- Markdown / TXT — auto-detected

## AI Result Statuses
- `MATCH` — Clause fully satisfied
- `VIOLATION` — Clause contradicted (red strikethrough + green AI answer)
- `PARTIALLY_SATISFIED` — Clause partially met (orange strikethrough + green AI answer)
- `NOT_FOUND` — Clause absent from document (blue AI suggestion)

## Base URL
`{{base_url}}` defaults to `http://localhost:8000`

item.name: Analyze Document

request.description:
## Analyze Document via Base64

Send a base64-encoded document (PDF, DOCX, MD, TXT) and clauses to analyze.

### Request Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document_base64` | string | **Yes** | Base64-encoded document content |
| `agreement_type` | string | No | Type of agreement |
| `agreement_details` | object | No | Date, city, state |
| `parties` | object | No | Landlord and tenant details |
| `property` | object | No | Property type, area, address |
| `clauses` | array | **Yes** | 1-100 clauses to analyze |

### Clause Object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Yes | Unique clause identifier |
| `title` | string | Yes | Clause title/name |
| `content` | string | No | Expected clause content |
| `value` | string | No | Alternative to `content` |
| `category` | string | No | Clause category |

### File Type Detection
The API auto-detects the file format using magic bytes:
- `%PDF-` for PDF
- `PK\x03\x04` for DOCX
- Otherwise treated as plain text

### Base64 Input Notes
- Supports optional data URI prefix: `data:application/pdf;base64,...`
- The prefix is automatically stripped

### Response
Returns `analysis_summary` array with per-clause results, `report_md_base64` and `summary_md_base64` (always included), and `jurisdiction` info.
